evals.prompt: In my kitchen drama the mother pours water from an unbranded white ceramic jug in shots 2, 5 and 9. In the last test the jug grew a made-up brand name. Do I need a prop sheet, and what should the shot prompts say?
evals.expected_output: A gate decision that recognises the jug as recurring, gives a positive plain-surface descriptor to repeat word for word, and offers a front and back sheet because the jug recurs and text drifted.
expectations: The output notes the jug recurs across three shots and so passes the recurrence row of the prop threshold.
The output gives a positive descriptor such as a plain white ceramic jug with a smooth solid glaze and nothing printed, to repeat word for word in every shot.
The output plans front and back views because the jug is rotationally even, with no side view by default.
Any sheet prompt describes every unprinted face positively as plain, with a short no-text exclusion after it.
The output does not generate an image or claim one exists.

evals.prompt: Make a prop sheet for the coffee cup the barista holds for one second in shot 4. It is a plain paper cup.
evals.expected_output: A text-only descriptor because the cup is generic and brief, noting it is below the threshold, unless the user insists on a sheet.
expectations: The output identifies the cup as generic, unbranded and briefly visible, below the prop threshold.
The output returns a text descriptor that states the plain surface positively, for example a plain white paper cup with nothing printed.
The output offers to write the sheet anyway if the user still wants one, and notes it is below the threshold.

evals.prompt: The ad features the client's real canned tuna on the table in every shot. Write the Seedream prop sheet prompt for the can.
evals.expected_output: A reuse-or-acquire handoff with no Seedream prompt, because an authorized real labeled product should be acquired rather than generated.
expectations: The output checks for an existing project asset first, then asks for or acquires the official or user-supplied packshot.
The output does not invent the brand's logo or label with Seedream.
The output records that an acquired asset uses generation none and skips prompt review.
